newsitem.title: HONG KONG: Jet Air allies with European partner.
newsitem.headline: Jet Air allies with European partner.

text.p: Jet Air International Group Ltd said on Monday two of its units have entered into an alliance with Germany's REWICO Speditions-und Schiffahrts GmbH to tap into emerging markets like Eastern Europe and South America.
REWICO has appointed Jet Air (HK) Ltd and Jet Dispatch (HK) Ltd as its exclusive air and ocean cargo agents in Hong Kong, China, Taiwan and Vietnam, the statement said.
Both units of Jet Air in return have assigned REWICO as their exclusive agent in Germany, other European countries and North and South America, it said.
REWICO is partly owned by Teege, Tietje & Sohn, an inland trucking company in Europe. Jet Air provides international air and sea freight forwarding services.
